csv_project_name: Engineering For Central Elden Walkability Improvement
csv_scope_of_work: Town of Herndon may be seeking a consultant to provide Engineering Services for The project to improve pedestrian safety, accessibility, and overall walkability of the south side of Elden Street between Center Street to the east and Main Drive to the west. The improvements include reconstructing approximately 0.3 miles of unsafe and substandard streetscape from a three to four-foot wide sidewalk abutting curb to a continuous five-foot wide sidewalk with brick pavers and a landscaped strip between the sidewalk and curb. The project also adds ADA-compliant curb ramps, high visibility crosswalks, and accessible pedestrian signalization at the intersection with Grace Street. The project may include relocation of existing overhead utility poles , which are currently placed in the middle of the existing sidewalk, to minimize conflicts between the poles and the sidewalk and better ensure ADA compliance.
csv_disciplines_requested: Landscape Architecture, Civil Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering
